[SWS_SM_00654] StateMachine marked as "ImpactedByUpdate"
⌈
During a call to PrepareUpdate, VerifyUpdate or PrepareRollback, the Mod-
elled Process controlling the StateMachine of type Controller shall mark a StateMachine as "ImpactedByUpdate", if any of the Function Groups managed
by the StateMachine is listed in the parameter passed to the method call.
